prompt_md: You saw a small triangle off one corner of a square table with one straight cut. How many corners does the table have now?
prompt_short: Saw one corner off a square table. How many corners now?
hint_md: Look at where the cut meets the two edges.
explain_intuition_md: Removing one corner creates two new ones, where the cut meets each edge. So you lose 1 and gain 2. Four minus one forgets the new corners.
